name: Yoga
overview: Scripture emphasizes meditation on God's law as a vital spiritual practice, encouraging believers to reflect on His Word day and night to live wisely and prosperously (Joshua 1:8; Psalms 1:2; Psalms 119:15). True meditation involves focusing the heart and mind on God's precepts and maintaining stillness to know and trust in Him (Psalms 19:14; Psalms 46:10; Isaiah 26:3). While meditation is biblical, it is centered on God’s revelation and not disconnected physical or spiritual exercises.
